cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Tell Me I Did Enough
cards.instruction: Get someone to reassure you that your effort, choice, or survival was enough.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You closed your copy of the speech, so I closed mine and finished. I stayed at the front. Was that enough?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I closed mine to put it on the chair. You skipped the last paragraph.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, copies away. I'm asking whether staying there counted; I nearly walked out before I started.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It counted. I'll help you practise that paragraph tomorrow.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could staying earn me tomorrow off? Tell me I can put the speech away for one day.

reason: Make copied confidence create a specific misunderstanding in the same emotional task; preserve B contribution and avoid turning vulnerable requests into rubric explanations.
